resolution.note: lane run removes empty read-only placeholders left in the main checkout and git dir; state check names them transient

title: Lane run removes sandbox placeholders a session left in the main checkout
body:
Why: 2026-11-13 while lane sessions ran, empty read-only files appeared in the MAIN checkout: .git/config.lock (17:04, broke git config writes, fixed around in 53969be) and .mcp.json (17:34, untracked, dirties git status). They are the harness sandbox placeholders over write-denied paths outside the worktree; lane run cleans placeholders only inside the lane worktree (sandboxPlaceholders in src/cli/lane-run.ts).
Outcome: after a lane session ends, lane run removes the empty untracked placeholder files the session left in the main checkout and its git dir (.git/config.lock, .mcp.json and the placeholderName set), never a non-empty or tracked file; while sessions run, krn state check names them as transient.
Proof: a lane-run test with a scripted KRN_LANE_CLAUDE that creates an empty read-only <main>/.mcp.json and <main>/.git/config.lock finds both gone after the run and a non-empty one kept.
